_doc.what: Per-asset parameters for refine_trellis_glb.py (Stage 2 of the TRELLIS.2 art pipeline, TASK-083). Law: CONVENTIONS.md 'Textured mesh law (TRELLIS.2 art pipeline)'.
_doc.merging: 'defaults' apply to every asset; per-asset keys override (dict values merge one level deep).
_doc.units: All *_ue values are Unreal units (= cm). The script works in Blender meters internally (1 m = 100 UE) and exports with apply_unit_scale=True, matching the blockout FBX convention.
_doc.mode: 'bake' = full remesh/decimate + Cycles CPU bake to D/N/ORM (standard). 'native' = keep TRELLIS's own mesh/UVs/textures, WebP->PNG convert only (escape hatch for bake artifacts). CLI --mode overrides.
_doc.fit_mode: 'height' = uniform scale so Z matches target (units — silhouette-preserving; X/Y deviation is warn-only in the report). 'box' = exact per-axis scale to the target box (buildings — guarantees the ±10% blockout-bounds ruling).
_doc.origin: Documentation of the origin rule; 'feet-center' (units) and 'ground-center' (buildings) are both implemented as XY-bbox-center at (0,0) with min Z = 0, per the TASK-014/037/038 blockout definitions.
_doc.pre_rotate_z_deg: Rotation applied before scaling so the model's FRONT faces Blender -Y (blockout facing contract). TRELLIS output orientation is unknown until the first live generation — tune per asset at the TASK-086/087 eyeball gate.
_doc.team_region: Selectors choose the minority face-set for material slot 0 'TeamRegion' (remainder = slot 1 '<CardID>PBR'). Each selector may carry 'box' (normalized conformed-bounds coords: x 0=-X..1=+X, y 0=front(-Y)..1=back(+Y), z 0=ground..1=top; face selected when its center lies inside) and/or 'normal' ({direction, min_dot}: face normal dot >= min_dot). Conditions within a selector AND together; selectors OR together. Selection over max_fraction of surface area (or zero faces) is a report WARNING, not a failure — the pre-import eyeball gate rules. Note markers (TASK-194 2026-07-18 adjudication): '_tuned' = values changed against the live generated mesh at an eyeball gate; '_verified' = original values confirmed correct against the SHIPPED Stage-2 refine_report + Cache preview renders; '_pending' = still a pre-generation guess (no mesh generated yet — quota-blocked).
_doc.ucx: Buildings only: authored UCX_SM_<CardID>_00.. box hulls exported inside the FBX. 'boxes' entries are {center:[x,y,z], size:[x,y,z]} in UE units in conformed space. Castle law: wall-footprint-exact, NEVER a full base slab (M1 ~410-unit placement dead-zone lesson). Units carry ucx:null — their <=4 simple hulls are generated at Stage-3 import (TASK-037 recipe), not authored here.
_doc.bake: cage_extrusion_ue / max_ray_distance_ue feed Cycles selected-to-active baking; ao_samples applies to the AO pass only (spec: 64 spp), 'samples' to all other passes.
_doc.trellis_resolution: OPTIONAL per-asset Stage-1 image_to_3d resolution pin, as a STRING (the Space expects the choice as a string; absent = trellis_generate.py's default '1024'). TASK-194 (2026-07-18) pins '1536' on the HERO assets (Castle, CrystalTower, ArrowTower, BombTower, BallistaTower) per the M7.5 quality directive. Applies to FUTURE re-gens ONLY — pinning re-runs nothing. trellis_generate.py currently takes --resolution on the CLI (script changes belong to the tooling lane, TASK-192/193): until the script reads this key, the operator passes --resolution per this pin on any re-gen; this key is the pin of record. Law: CONVENTIONS 'Meshy second engine (M7.5)' (hero assets are the 1536-class candidates).
_doc.albedo_delight: Optional per-asset override for the Stage-2 albedo de-light/brighten pass (TASK-193; conservative-ON default lives in-script; refine_trellis_glb.py READS this key if present). Schema per TASK-193's implementation. TASK-225 (2026-07-19, Ruling B): overrides PINNED for the recorded-dark set (Ogre, Knight, Cavalry, Pikeman, MilitiaMob) at the TASK-195-proven tuned values {ao_divide_strength 1.0, ao_floor 0.25, gamma 0.55, gain 1.2}, tempered per asset where the rebake preview warranted (recorded in each asset's _note). All other assets keep the in-script conservative defaults.

albedo_delight._note: TASK-342 CHROMA-FIDELITY override (2026-07-27, per the per-asset albedo_delight override law + CHROMA-FIDELITY GATE). History: the TASK-312 locked-profile pin {1.0, 0.25, g0.55, x1.2} was lost post-crash (re-pinned this task first), and its bake shipped chalky: alpha-masked re-measure showed preview-front luma retention 1.5597 (ABOVE the 1.25 bleach line — the recorded 0.7505 was backdrop-contaminated, denominator inflated 2x) with chroma retention 0.7594 and the dominant-cluster C* at 0.56x. MECHANISM: per-channel gamma 0.55 compresses channel ratios (the desaturator); gain is a pure linear scalar (chroma-raising). FIX: move the entire lift onto AO-divide + gain — gamma 1.0 kills the ratio compression, gain 1.7 holds the UV-norm floor. Measured on the final bake (validated method: albedo anchors 4dp x6, retention anchors Castle 1.0153/1.0155 + Ogre 0.9402/0.9399 + 0.8121/0.8124): UV-norm 0.2676 (floor 0.2536 PASS), preview-front luma retention 1.0141, chroma retention 0.9682, top-2 hue shifts 2.7/6.0 deg. Structural note: the 0.2536 floor itself binds against dark-palette concepts — gain below ~1.6 breaks the floor.

ucx._comment: TASK-555 (2026-08-15), WR-S1 / WR-S2 row 11 - 22 hulls -> 25. The SHELL hulls are x3 of the TASK-348 set; the APPROACH is NOT x3, it is RE-DERIVED, and that is the whole point of the task. THE DEFECT A NAIVE x3 WOULD HAVE SHIPPED: the approach chain 0 -> 20 -> 58 scales to 0 -> 60 -> 174, i.e. a MAX STEP OF 114 uu, against AHeroCharacter::HeroMaxStepHeight = 50 and Config/DefaultEngine.ini:330 AgentMaxStepHeight = 35.0 (CellHeight 20 => RecastNavMeshGenerator.cpp:5280 walkableClimb = CeilToInt(35/20) = 2 cells = 40 uu effective). NOTHING would have entered the castle, and every bounds readback would still have PASSED. RE-DERIVED APPROACH: five treads approach_tread_01..05 with tops 29 / 58 / 87 / 116 / 145, the sixth riser being the step onto floor_slab_hall at z 174 => SIX EQUAL RISERS OF 29.0 uu (<= the 40 law, <= the 40 effective Recast climb, <= 35 nominal AgentMaxStepHeight with 6 uu of margin, <= 45 unit MaxStepHeight, <= 50 hero). The SHIPPED 38-uu riser was ABOVE the nominal 35 and survived only on the ceil-to-40 cell quantisation - the re-derivation removes that fragility. A RAMP WAS STRUCTURALLY UNAVAILABLE, NOT REJECTED ON TASTE: the collision authority is Tools/reimport_meshes.py::_apply_box_collision, which writes unreal.KBoxElem center/x/y/z and never sets a rotation => an inclined hull cannot be expressed. Tread y-boundaries are the MEASURED flush points where the visual apron ramp (3.074 deg, angle-preserved by the uniform scale) crosses each tread top, so every hull top sits AT or BELOW the visual surface: never floating, sunk <= 29 uu (the shipped design was sunk <= 28 uu at a THIRD of this size, i.e. this is relatively 3x tighter). approach_tread_01's outer face is the measured mesh front edge y = -3630; no hull extends past it into open air. tread_05 (top 145) carries the gate passage, where the mesh's natural floor dips to ~128: float 17 uu vs the 46 uu a flat 174 passage floor would have given. CONSEQUENCE NAMED TO TASK-557/566/569: a x3 GateBlockerRelativeLocation z 852 / extent z 678 puts the blocker BOTTOM at 174, i.e. 29 uu above the 145 passage floor - harmless (a 29 uu gap passes no capsule: agent radius 34, half-height 88) but if a flush seal is wanted the arithmetic is RelLoc.z 837.5 / extent.z 692.5. INHERITED x3 (unchanged in kind): door-gapped perimeter walls (gate collision gap x -762..+798 = 1560 clear; lintel bottom z 1530 -> gate clear COLLISION height 1356 over the 174 slab; lintel top 2430; visual arch spring 1410 / apex 2310), keep/tower hulls, and the 'arcade_seal' closing the meshed east arcade slot so the gate stays the ONLY opening. Hull faces match the NARROWEST visual extent per side (units never collide with air; penetrations in the TASK-555 drift table). Walkable interior (gate/corridor/halls above z=174) stays hull-free - probe-verified. HISTORY: TASK-348 (2026-07-28) authored the 22-hull door-gapped set under the UCX DOOR-GAP law, superseding the TASK-087 11-solid-box set.
ucx._comment_task611: TASK-611 (2026-08-16), WR-45 / W10-R5..R7 - THE FLOOR-SINK R1 REPAIR, manifest-only (no visual byte changed; Castle.fbx untouched; the FBX's embedded 25-hull UCX_ set is now historical - this boxes array is the sole authority per TL-2, applied via the same-path collision write, never delete+recreate). 25 -> 35 hulls. Evidence: handoffs/TASK-597-artist.md (SINK MAP) + handoffs/TASK-598-buildmaster.md (live confirmation, both castles). (i) TREAD SPLIT: the four 29-uu ramp risers (29->58->87->116->145) each split into two 14.5-uu risers at the MEASURED flush points of the 63-sample centre visual profile in Cache/Castle/rescale_report.json (crossings: 58 @ y -3447, 72.5 @ -3161.5, 87 @ -2876.5, 101.5 @ -2614, 116 @ -2344.5, 130.5 @ -2072.5, 145 @ -1796.5). Old approach_tread_01..05 superseded by approach_tread_01..09, tops 29/43.5/58/72.5/87/101.5/116/130.5/145. TWO RISERS COULD NOT SPLIT, BY MEASUREMENT (declared SC-15 departures from the 6->12 spec figure): (a) the ground-lip riser 0->29 - the apron front edge (y -3630) already reads visual 36.58..48.3, so no flush point exists at or below 29, and the 43.5 crossing sits only ~14 uu from the front edge; a tread that shallow risks Recast dropping the intermediate span and quantising the entry climb to 43.5 > the 40-uu effective walkableClimb, killing unit entry. The 29/43.5 boundary is therefore placed at y -3560 (depth-70 minimum, not the -3615.8 flush point), leaving a DECLARED 56-uu lip strip (y ~ -3616..-3560) with residual centre-route sink 14.5..22.1 uu - the R1 floor; R2 (visual re-derivation) is the held escape if the eye still objects. (b) the hall riser 145->174 - the interior visual jumps 128.6 -> 174.0 in a vertical step at y ~350 (through_route_floor table), so no 159.5 flush point exists; the 29-uu riser onto the slab stands and lies entirely in FLOAT territory (zero sink contribution). Result: 10 risers = 29 + 8x14.5 + 29; every riser <= 29 <= nominal AgentMaxStepHeight 35 with margin; every tread depth >= 70 > agent diameter 68. (ii) BERM BLOCKERS berm_block_01..06: two mirrored 3-box structural walls filling the C2/C3 berm volumes (|x| 720..1470, y -2440..-1930, bottoms -60) to their measured visual tops (497 / 411 / 219, from columns S1 496.7 and S4 410.7 and the y -1990 row 218.9), making S1-S4 unwalkable/supported-at-visual; inner faces at exactly |x| = 720 so the centre walk corridor is not encroached. (iii) SHELF WIDENING: treads 01..06 (the y-range of old treads 01..03) widen from x -960..990 to -1470..1470, putting the measured C1 flat shelf (face ~3 deg) on real treads; S5 becomes supported (declared residual ~44 uu - the shelf rides ~0..35 uu above the centre ramp; R1 cannot close that without per-flank geometry, which is R2 territory). Treads 07..09 keep x -882..918 (the gate approach; its flanks are the berm walls). (iv) F3 RIDER (taken, flag resolved on the board): the 145 tread (approach_tread_09) extends to y +270 (= the hall_main carve south face) and floor_slab_hall now starts there (y-span 270..1200, x/z unchanged) - corridor float drops 46 -> ~17; the slab volume removed (y -1170..270 outside the corridor width) lay entirely under uncarved solid masonry, unreachable by any capsule. CRUMBLE TRIO (W6-R2): this identical box set is applied to SM_Castle_Crumble01/02/03 in the same pass - per-stage collision invariance is the commit gate. Gate aperture, lintel and every shell hull: UNCHANGED.

Sorcerer._pre_rotate_source: TASK-375-FACING-FIX (2026-08-02) -- SET TO 180.0. ROOT CAUSE, MEASURED NOT INFERRED: the Sorcerer is the FIRST UNIT exported through Stage 2 AFTER the TASK-348 MIRROR-FIX landed (2026-07-28). refine_trellis_glb.py::_ue_handedness_precomp bakes mirror_Y + a winding flip into the written FBX so that UE's RH->LH import negation restores conformed space. Every other unit FBX in Content/RawAssets/ was exported BEFORE that date (Footman/Cleric/Wizard/Archer/Knight/Cavalry/Longbowman/Miner/Sapper/Pikeman/MilitiaMob 2026-07-26, Ogre 2026-07-27) and therefore carries NO pre-compensation. Consequence: the shipped fleet lands in UE Y-MIRRORED (conformed front -Y arrives at UE-local +Y, which is exactly what ASummonedUnit::ResolveSkeletalVisual's comment records and why SkeletalVisualYawOffset = -90 is correct for them), while the pre-compensated Sorcerer lands UN-mirrored (conformed front -Y arrives at UE-local -Y) and therefore reads 180 degrees wrong at the same -90. PROOF (headless Blender renders of the SHIPPED files, identical ortho camera, albedo textures): Content/RawAssets/Footman.fbx rendered from -Y shows the FRONT (face, spear, kite shield, lion tabard); Content/RawAssets/Sorcerer.fbx rendered from -Y shows the BACK (no mask, ribbed cowl across the shoulders, spine strap) and from +Y shows the FRONT (carved stone mask with both eye sockets and the muzzle, knotted sash bow, planted monolith). Numeric corroboration of the UE Y-negation: this FBX measures Y -39.212..+39.157 on disk and TASK-371 read it back in UE at Y -39.157..+39.212 -- an exact negation. WHY 180 AND NOT SOME OTHER ANGLE, AND WHY THE SIGN DOES NOT MATTER: Rz(180) == Rz(-180) (diag(-1,-1,1)), and it commutes with the export mirror diag(1,-1,1), so a 180 pre-rotation flips the final UE-local facing by exactly 180 regardless of how many Y-mirrors sit in the chain -- there is no sign to get wrong. Net effect: UE-local = Rz(180) o conformed, a PURE ROTATION, so the Sorcerer's front arrives at UE-local +Y exactly like the fleet (C++ -90 correct, static VisualMesh ritual -90 correct, GhostYawOffset -90 correct) AND its chirality is preserved (monolith stays on the figure's own right, as in Concepts/Sorcerer.png). DELIBERATE, DOCUMENTED CONSEQUENCE: in CONFORMED/preview space this asset now fronts +Y, so Cache/Sorcerer/previews/preview_BACK.png shows the character's FRONT and preview_FRONT.png shows its back. That inversion is the compensation, not a defect -- do not 'fix' it back to 0.0. team_region selectors are UNAFFECTED: the two x-windows [0.0,0.4] and [0.6,1.0] form a union symmetric under u->1-u, the y window [0.05,0.95] is symmetric under v->1-v, and the +Z normal rule is invariant under a Z rotation -- the two islands merely swap which physical plate carries the 'slab_mantle_left'/'_right' label (re-measured after the re-run: same face count, same area fraction). SYSTEMIC FLAG FOR THE MANAGER (NOT fixed here, deliberately): every FUTURE unit through Stage 2 will inherit the same +180 need until either _ue_handedness_precomp is reconsidered for the unit lane or the whole fleet is re-exported through it. Touching that is a 25-asset blast radius and would disturb TASK-348/350's castle collision/gate alignment, so it is a manager/Jonathan decision, not an art call.
